newsitem.title: USA: Libbey Inc raises credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Libbey Inc raises credit facility.

text.p: Libbey Inc said on Thursday it has agreed with its bank lenders to increase its revolving credit facility to $380 million from $300 million.

Under the terms of the amended revolving credit facility, the maturity date has been extended to May 2002 from October 1999 and also borrowing rates, under certain circumstances, are lower than its prior facility.

Libbey said it expects the increase in the size of the facility will accommodate the financing needs associated with the proposed acquisition of the business known as WorldCrisa and investment in Vitrocrisa that was announced on March 10, 1997.
